source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Your HERETIC ASTARTES models lose [Dark Pacts](vsdata:ability/chaos-space-marines.dark-pacts) and gain [[ASSAULT](vsdata:weapon-ability/assault)] on their ranged weapons. At muster, forgo the Cults of the [Dark Gods army rule](vsdata:ability/chaos-space-marines.cults-of-the-dark-gods). As your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins, name one enemy unit as your Vendetta target until your following Command phase starts. Your HERETIC ASTARTES models other than the DAMNED may reroll hits against it. In your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), a HERETIC ASTARTES unit can Default to Doctrine when it arrives or is picked to move, unless it is Battle-shocked. Resolve its [Battle-shock test](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock) first. Then choose one permission for the rest of the turn: shoot and charge after [Falling Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back), or charge after [Advancing](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move).

vendetta.expires: start of next own Command phase
